name: Getlead
description: B2B lead-generation platform: access to 420M+ global contacts, lead scraping via your own API, and outreach "with up to 99% inbox delivery" in one tool (company-stated). Pricing: Starter €19.90/mo, Freelancer & Founder €99.90/mo, Agency+ €199.90/mo (company-stated). Claims 12,400+ teams (founder-stated). Founded Oct 2025, Poland. 51 active subscriptions; L30 profit margin 60%.

mentions.evidence: MRR $2,098 · 51 active subscriptions Last 30 days $11,334 (+25.0%) · last 3 months $28,025 · last 6 months $56,301 Last 12 months $98,079 · all-time $100,279 L30 profit margin 60% (TrustMRR snapshot) Note: lumpy months — $11,431 (Dec 2025), $2,645 (Feb), ~$11k (Apr–May), $5,651 (Aug), $10,754 (Sep), $8,244 Oct MTD. MRR snapshot is far below L30, so most cash is non-recurring. Revenue synced 18 October 2026 ~05:30 Warsaw.
mentions.indieAngle: Narrow it: one verified B2B database for one country or vertical (Polish companies from KRS/CEIDG + verified emails, or EU dental clinics), sold as credit packs. Data sourcing and GDPR are the moat and the risk.

whyItPrints: Lists of emails plus a sending tool — the oldest B2B purchase on the internet. Revenue is lumpy (likely annual plans/credit packs: L30 far above the MRR snapshot), but it crossed $100k all-time in under a year from Poland.
